name: list_add
description: Add items to a list (to-do, shopping, packing). Creates the list if it does not exist; a new list also appears on the panel.

list.description: List name in the user's language, e.g. "Weekend to-dos".

items.description: Items to add. May be empty to just create the list.

name: list_read
description: Read a list with its open and checked items.

name: list_check
description: Check off items of a list as done.

items.description: Items as they appear in the list.

name: list_remove
description: Remove items from a list, or all of them when items is empty. An empty list stays but is hidden from the panel.
